system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Bastard

Granted power: +1 AC while using a shield. Once/day: for the encounter, attacks against a touched creature have Disadvantage.

Allegiance: Lawful Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Helm in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: name the one person or place you guard above all (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
